name: estuary
description: Lets Claude Code agents claim, work, and hand off tasks in the self-hosted AI task manager: MCP tools over its REST API, the task-workflow skill, a SessionStart hook that lists the tasks you still hold, and a SessionEnd hook that hands unfinished tasks back to todo.

api_url.title: Task manager API URL
api_url.description: Base URL of the REST API, including /api/v1.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Who you act as, sent as X-Actor on every request: agent:<name>, lowercase. Leave empty to derive one per checkout: agent:claude-code@<project>, or agent:claude-code@<project>/<worktree> inside a git worktree, so parallel sessions in different worktrees hold their claims separately. Two sessions in the same checkout share the derived actor; set this (or TASKS_ACTOR) per session if you run that way.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Only if the server sets API_TOKEN (self-hosted deployments). Leave empty for a local API.

server_path.title: MCP server path
server_path.description: Absolute path to a built apps/mcp/dist/index.js, to run a local build of the server. Leave empty to use the published estuary-mcp package through npx (pinned to this plugin's version), or the checkout's own build when the plugin is installed from a checkout's local marketplace.
